# Data-quality rules

63 rules across 5 feeds, declared in `config/contracts/`. Actions: block 5, quarantine 39, repair 6, warn 13. Dimensions: completeness 11, conformity 17, consistency 1, integrity 6, timeliness 4, uniqueness 5, validity 19.

- **block** - the whole file is stopped; the feed does not publish past it until it is re-delivered, or a steward accepts it (it loads) or waives it (the feed publishes without it).
- **quarantine** - the row is held with the rule's id. If every rule it failed is *retryable*, it is re-checked on later runs and released when it passes (a patient registered late, a code mapping added); otherwise it waits for a steward.
- **repair** - fixed because the fix is provable (leading zeros, letter case), and recorded.
- **warn** - recorded and reported; the row goes through.

Every firing is a row in `audit.row_findings` (run, file, row, rule, detail), summarised per run in `dq_scorecard.csv`.

## roster

| id | rule | type | dimension | action | retry | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ROS-001 | The snapshot has not shrunk | volume | completeness | block |  | stop below 0.9x the usual delivery; A roster snapshot far smaller than the last one would orphan every clinical feed; the load is stopped. |
| ROS-002 | Medical record numbers keep their leading zeros | repair | conformity | repair |  | Numeric record number shorter than eight digits (leading zeros lost in a spreadsheet); zero-padded. |
| ROS-003 | Record number, name and birth date are present | required | completeness | quarantine |  | columns `patient_id`, `last_name`, `birth_date_raw` |
| ROS-004 | Record number is eight digits | expression | conformity | quarantine |  |  |
| ROS-005 | Birth date is a real date | parse | validity | quarantine |  | column `birth_date` |
| ROS-006 | Birth date is plausible | expression | validity | quarantine |  |  |
| ROS-007 | Clinic codes are upper case | repair | conformity | repair |  | Lower-case clinic code standardised. |
| ROS-008 | Attributed clinic exists | in_reference | integrity | quarantine |  | column `site_id` |
| ROS-009 | Sex is a recognised value | mapped | validity | quarantine |  | column `sex` |
| ROS-010 | One row per record number | key_conflict | uniqueness | quarantine |  | The same record number arrived twice with different details; neither version is guessed. |
| ROS-011 | Phone numbers that cannot be standardised are blanked | expression | conformity | warn |  | Phone number is not ten digits after removing punctuation; stored blank, original kept in the load. |
| ROS-012 | Race and ethnicity are recorded for most patients | completeness | completeness | warn |  | at least 95% recorded; Equity reporting depends on recorded race and ethnicity. |
| ROS-013 | Payer type is recognised | mapped | validity | warn |  | column `payer_type`; Unrecognised payer type reported as unknown. |

| id | rule | type | dimension | action | retry | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SCR-001 | Delivery volume is in the usual range | volume | completeness | block |  | stop below 0.25x the usual delivery (usual = median of recent loads; checked once it is at least 40 rows) |

| SCR-006 | Screening date is not after the extract | not_future | validity | quarantine |  | column `screen_date` |
| SCR-007 | Item responses are whole numbers within the instrument's range | expression | validity | quarantine |  | stops the file if more than 5% of rows fail |
| SCR-008 | Social-needs answers are Y, N or D | expression | validity | quarantine |  |  |
| SCR-009 | Administration mode is recognised | mapped | validity | quarantine | yes | column `admin_mode` |
| SCR-010 | Patient is on the roster | on_roster | integrity | quarantine | yes | column `patient_id` |
| SCR-011 | One version of each screening per file | key_conflict | uniqueness | quarantine |  |  |
| SCR-012 | Platform totals agree with the item responses | expression | consistency | warn |  | The platform's total disagrees with the sum of the items; the computed total is used. |
| SCR-013 | Late rows for a closed measurement year are announced | closed_period | timeliness | warn |  | column `screen_date` |
